job: Check floating-reference model translation and reject unsafe pass-stage assumptions before native adoption
limitations: ATL431 manufacturer model excludes loop behavior and temperature. No stability or hot qualification from these runs.
Generic MOSFET LEVEL1 fit is a sensitivity surrogate, not an IXTP3N100D2 validated model. VTO sweep with fixed KP is not a statistical device bound.
LM317L-N is behavioral. No reverse conduction, thermal shutdown, internal fault protection or measured dynamics are asserted.
The extra warm resistor approximates only the nominal prior load; it does not reproduce the nonlinear tube amplifier.
100ohm drain feed plus680ohm source resistor replaces the previous680ohm drain-feed topology for this experiment only. Neither is adopted.
Exact input envelope, parts, fault interruption, reversal, thermal/SOA, socket/carrier, sourcing and populated fit remain open.
done_condition: Reproducible adapter fixtures and bounded candidate evidence, explicit failures and unchanged native hashes. Not circuit qualification.
estimated_effort: One scoped simulation and reporting wave
human_evidence: Exact device/revision, supported models or bench response, hot/fault protection, sourcing and mechanical assembly before adoption.
